# Ruzuku

> > Ruzuku is a no-transaction-fee online course platform designed for coaches, educators, and course creators to build, sell, and teach courses with integrated payment processing and community engagement features.

Ruzuku provides a comprehensive course platform with zero platform transaction fees, supporting multiple payment methods (Stripe, PayPal) and integrations (Zoom, Zapier). The platform emphasizes ease of use, community building, and course monetization for educators across diverse disciplines.

## Getting Started

- [Online Course Platform for Coaches & Educators | Ruzuku](https://www.ruzuku.com): Ruzuku homepage: create, sell, teach online courses with no transaction fees.
- [How Ruzuku Works - Create, Sell & Teach Online Courses](https://www.ruzuku.com/how-it-works): Ruzuku's 5-stage platform for creating, selling, and teaching courses.
- [Pricing - No Transaction Fees, Unlimited Courses | Ruzuku](https://www.ruzuku.com/pricing): Ruzuku pricing plans: Free, Core ($99/mo), Pro ($199/mo) with zero fees.

## Core Features

- [Create Courses Easily | How Ruzuku Works](https://www.ruzuku.com/how-it-works/create): Drag-and-drop course builder with video, audio, PDFs, quizzes support.
- [Sell Courses With Zero Transaction Fees | How Ruzuku Works](https://www.ruzuku.com/how-it-works/sell): Stripe and PayPal integration with zero platform transaction fees.
- [Build Course Community & Engagement | How Ruzuku Works](https://www.ruzuku.com/how-it-works/engage): Community features: discussions, live sessions, progress tracking.

## Integrations & Payments

- [Integrations - Connect Zoom, Stripe, PayPal & Zapier](https://www.ruzuku.com/integrations): Ruzuku integrations: Zoom, Stripe, PayPal, Zapier for automation.
- [Stripe Payments with 0% Platform Fees | Ruzuku](https://www.ruzuku.com/integrations/stripe): Stripe integration for payments, subscriptions, and payment plans.
- [PayPal Integration | Ruzuku](https://www.ruzuku.com/integrations/paypal): PayPal payment option to reduce checkout abandonment globally.
